Council Meetings

Elected Members

Council comprises of seven (7) councillors covering the district.

 Cr Keith Carter                        Cr Melissa Harms                   Cr Steven Carter                   Cr Jemma Counsel               Cr Diane Cream                    Cr Shannon Dawson                   Cr Shane Hickleton

     

  President                                Deputy President                         Councillor                                    Councillor                                  Councillor                            Councillor                              Councillor

Council Meetings are held on the 4th Tuesday of every month between the months of February and November and commence at 5pm. Members of the public are welcome to attend.

There are no Council meetings held in January.

The December Council meeting is held on the third Tuesday in December.

The Council Chambers are located at the Shire Offices on Johnston Street, Dalwallinu.

For past meetings Minutes and Agendas, please click here.
